body.x: Orange Biomed Co., Ltd. (co-CEOs Unghyeon Ko and Yeaseul Park) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will occur from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. At the K-Startup Pavilion, it will showcase its portable HbA1c monitor, the "OBM rapid A1c. "

The OBM rapid A1c is a groundbreaking device designed to simplify diabetes management by enabling accurate and convenient hemoglobin A1c testing at home. Hemoglobin A1c, a critical indicator of blood glucose control for diabetes patients, offers a stable measure less affected by testing time or short-term fluctuations, unlike traditional glucose tests. Elevated glycated hemoglobin levels increase blood viscosity, damage blood vessels and tissues, and contribute to diabetes complications.

Developed to make diabetes and its complications more manageable, the OBM rapid A1c leverages microfluidic technology to measure glycated hemoglobin—making it the world's first device. The device's ability to deliver reliable and precise measurements using only a small blood sample underscores its innovation and potential to revolutionize home diabetes care.

Yeaseul Park, Co-CEO of Orange Biomed, stated, "Introducing OBM rapid A1c at CES 2025, the world's largest consumer electronics show, is a significant milestone. By empowering individuals in areas with limited access to hospitals to manage diabetes complications using cutting-edge medical technology, we aim to contribute to greater healthcare equity."
